description: Checks for up to 25 German companies at once whether they are still active: verdict alive / dead / unknown, with the date of the status (as_of) and an explanation. Most companies are currently 'unknown'; 'unknown' does not mean alive. Intended for requests where the user wants to check a list of companies, e.g. cleaning CRM data or reviewing a supplier list. Example user questions: 'Are these 10 companies still registered?', 'Which of my supplier list are dissolved?' Full profiles per company come from get_company_profile. Max 25 companies per call.

registers.description: List of company_number_norm values (max 25). Format: {CourtLetter}{4digits}_{HRB|HRA|PR|GnR|VR}{Nummer}, e.g. ['K1101_HRB52093'] (HRB 52093, Amtsgericht Hamburg). Court codes cannot be derived from city names.

name: check_company_status
title: Status mehrerer Firmen prüfen
